params.headline: Why every app wants an answer right now
params.highlight: Email, WhatsApp, Slack and Telegram: every single one wants an answer right now.
before: Researchers surveyed 2,000 office workers about how they spend their day. The average person checks email or chat more than 70 times between nine and five.
Most of those messages are short. But each one asks for a decision: what to say, how to say it, and when.
after: Experts say the cost is not the typing. It is the constant switching between tasks and tones, which leaves people drained before lunch.
